# Requirements Quality Checklist: LLM Post-Processing

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the English of the 003 spec — completeness, clarity, consistency and coverage of the post-processing requirements (FR-09, FR-24, NFR-04, NFR-05, NFR-11) before planning
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied (no interaction possible): depth Standard; audience reviewer of the spec and plan; focus clusters: failure handling / timeouts, and privacy / secrets. Items marked `[x]` were resolved by the spec author during this run (spec edited, note inline); open items need the owner or a dependent feature.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is it specified what the request contains (instruction, text to process, model) and which parts play which role? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for every failure mode of the endpoint — unreachable, connect timeout, total timeout, 401/403, other HTTP status, malformed body, empty reply? [Completeness, Spec §US2, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Is behaviour defined when the model returns commentary or a thinking block instead of only the rewrite? [Gap → resolved: Edge Cases "Reply is commentary"]
- [x] CHK004 Is the starter prompt's text specified, not only its existence? [Gap → resolved: Key Entities "Starter prompt"]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it specified whether the starter prompt is localized (Russian UI → Russian starter prompt) or one English text? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities] — spec assumes one English text; owner may prefer a localized one (FR-15 covers "user-visible text").
- [x] CHK006 Is behaviour defined for transcripts that exceed the model's context or provider limits? [Gap → resolved: Edge Cases "Very long transcript"]
- [x] CHK007 Is a user-visible "post-processing in progress" state required while the step can take up to 15 s? [Gap → resolved: Edge Cases "What the user sees while post-processing runs" — 001's overlay "processing" state covers it]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is the start point of the 15 s timeout defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004 — "from the start of the step"]
- [x] CHK009 Are the reason categories enumerated and mapped unambiguously to conditions (e.g. connect timeout → "cannot reach", not "timeout")? [Clarity, Spec §US2, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "malformed URL" for the post-processing base URL defined identically to the transcription base URL validation? [Clarity, Dependency on 004, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK011 Is "trim" defined (which whitespace, inner line breaks kept)? [Clarity, Clarification Q3, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 Is the FR-25 tray error state consistent with a dictation whose text was delivered but whose post-processing was skipped? [Consistency, Clarification Q4, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK013 Are the connect (5 s) and total (15 s) timeouts consistent with FR-24 and with each other? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Is the privacy statement consistent with NFR-05 when the local engine is combined with post-processing on? [Consistency, Spec §US3-6, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK015 Is the "final transcript" used by history consistent with the glossary (post-processed, or raw when skipped)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Can SC-003 be measured with a stated tolerance? [Measurability → resolved: SC-003 tolerance ≤ 0.5 s]
- [x] CHK017 Does SC-005 name the artifacts scanned for leaked key, prompt and transcript text? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK018 Does every Must failure branch (FR-09 failure, FR-24 15 s) appear as an acceptance scenario? [Coverage, Spec §US2-1..US2-5]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are retry (FR-11) and ordering (FR-23) interactions with post-processing specified? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Is the "post-processing off" path specified as making no network call? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK021 Are TLS/proxy failures categorised? [Coverage → resolved: Edge Cases "TLS or proxy failure"]
- [ ] CHK022 Is a "Test connection" for the post-processing endpoint intentionally excluded? [Gap, Assumption] — FR-14 names API engines only; owner to confirm.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK023 Is the key's storage location, separation from the transcription key and absence from logs specified? [Security, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK024 Is the prompt classed as user content that must not be logged? [Privacy, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK025 Is prompt injection through dictated text addressed? [Security → resolved: starter prompt text, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Is masking of the post-processing key in the settings window (display, copy) specified? [Security, Dependency on 004]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK027 Are the dependencies on 001 (pipeline, HTTP client, timeouts source, notifications) and 004 (fields, key UI, i18n) documented? [Dependency, Spec header, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK028 Does the requirements' first-run default list (FR-21) include post-processing defaults? [Gap in docs/requirements.md] — resolved: requirements v4 FR-21 lists post-processing off + starter prompt (owner 2026-10-02).
